typography.usage: Retain source reading hierarchy; fallback is an explicit guide production choice where extraction is incomplete.

recognitionRules: Use a blue-gray workspace with clear task labels and evidence notes.
Keep the summary count separate from individual task details.
Use rust for unresolved attention points, with text labels beside it.
Give each task a visible action and a place for supporting evidence.

principles: Name the choice, its owner and the condition that makes it complete.
Use the identity’s sample as a rhythm and vocabulary reference, not as a factual project claim.
voice.sample: Ready means the work can be inspected, not just marked done.
voice.sampleStatus: Original fictional brand copy authored for this guide, not a quotation or factual claim.
avoid: Avoid certainty about forecasts, capacity or commitments that are still provisional.
Avoid invented testimonials, performance claims and quotation attribution.
voice.secondaryExample: This is the assumption; this is the decision it affects.
voice.cadence: Short opening, concrete follow-through; vary sentence length for explanation.

logoDirection: Use READY FOR REVIEW in Arial with an open rectangular corner and a short blue rule. No default checkmark or green seal.
invariants: Use a blue-gray workspace with clear task labels and evidence notes.
Keep the summary count separate from individual task details.
Use rust for unresolved attention points, with text labels beside it.
adaptations: A compact view can show the next required action and its evidence.
Do not hide unresolved items behind a completion percentage.
Keep the full name with any new symbol until the audience can recognize it independently.

fonts.sourceFontDependency: Arial is a separately licensed Microsoft/system font; not bundled.

clearSpaceRule: Keep one half of the main wordmark cap height clear around the full silhouette, including its source-derived supporting device.

minimumSize.status: production minimum based on rendered 220/180px wordmark and 32/64px symbol inspection; verify again for unusual substrates
